notes.title: Villainous Newsletter Launch
notes.content:
Greetings Villains!

We've launched our brand new newsletter, so now you can keep up to date with all the mischievous happenings at the evilest game studio in town.

[h3]What can you expect  when signing up?[/h3]

As a special treat you will be able to download a creepy Harvest Hunt wallpaper once you sign up, so your screens can enter the spooky season in style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41418617/5411cf71199c7ff553d8ab3c6844fd6bbed10bb8.png[/img]

We're also planning to:

[list]
[*] Keep you up to date with all major evil schemes at our studio
[*] Give you exclusive behind the scenes peeks at the development of our games
[*] Let you be the first to know about discounts and sales
[/list]

[h3]Sign-ups[/h3]

Head over to our [url=https://subscribepage.io/UuOCX4]sign-up page[/url] to join and start your villainous journey. 
Remember you'll have to confirm your subscription via the confirmation email before you're fully initiated!

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale 2022
notes.content:
[h1]Hot summer comes with hot news![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41418617/a294ef7bab45c05e6c1473e07874d26ea4a50797.png[/img]

Steam Summer sale is on, and you can download [b]Horror Stories: PLEASE COMPLY[/b] with a [b]22%[/b] discount!
The sale will continue until July 7th, so it's time to revisit your wishlists ːsteamthumbsupː

Thank you for your continuous support! Please share your experiences with us!

notes.title: Lunar New Year Sale 2022
notes.content:
[h1]Happy Lunar New Year everyone![/h1]

Our CMD:Studio team is celebrating this traditional festival, and we invite you to join us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41418617/467bafc270b4169ccabe6309935004eecbc747b8.png[/img]

For the duration of the Steam Lunar New Year Sale you can purchase [b]Horror Stories: PLEASE COMPLY[/b] with a [b]30%[/b] discount. So if it’s been sitting in your Wishlist, now is the best time to COMPLY and try it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41418617/6c2f2350b8b01ced1daf127e35df560d44da36a0.png[/img]

We’ve been working hard to release the update, which includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Performance optimisation[/b]. You can enjoy the full experience even on a machine with lower technical specs without any loss to the game’s quality.
[*] [b]Disk space[/b]. The overall game size is now reduced to ~900MB (half the original size!).
[*] [b]Achievements[/b]. We added 12 Steam achievements for you to collect. Let’s see how many you can uncover!
[/list]

We would also like to thank you for playing Horror Stories: PLEASE COMPLY. Your support is priceless, and we hope you share your experience with us!
